subject_session: 10 animals; example sub-A3701_ses-191119 (all sub-A37xx/A55xx non-opto sessions, 998 units)

headline_stat.name: fraction HD cells / median decoding error

stated_limitation: A spatial control rules out the obvious confound, since recomputing each cell's preferred direction separately within the four spatial quadrants of the arena shifts it by a median of only 5 degrees, so the tuning is directional and not positional.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000939 is the canonical Peyrache/Duszkiewicz PoSub head-direction dataset, exactly the standard choice for this phenomenon.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile with a byte-range cache, correct extraction of spike times/HD series/epochs/sleep states across 10 animals, using the authors' own quality flags.
justification.analysis: Circular statistics, a circular-shift null with a conjunctive criterion, split-half stability, cross-environment rotation, Bayesian decoding, a NeMoS GLM with cyclic basis, and a spatial-quadrant control together form a correct and unusually complete treatment.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (66% HD, MVL 0.76, 1.5 bits/spike, 36 deg width, 93% author recovery, 9.15 deg decoding error) reproduces exactly from the committed results pickle and is internally consistent with the figures.
justification.figures: All nine figures are labeled with units and sample sizes, examples are chosen by split-half correlation strength (the effect itself), and the phenomenon is unmistakable in every panel.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to the evidence, discrepancies (author-flag recovery, cross-environment residuals, per-state animal counts) are explained, and the write-up states what each control does and does not rule out without overreaching.
